result.summary: The page shows two main visual issues: a restaurant name is truncated in the horizontal list, and the last visible card in the vertical list is clipped by the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the card, so the full name is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Increase card width, allow the name to wrap, or use an ellipsis (...) to indicate truncation instead of abrupt clipping.

issues.description: The second card under 'Popular right now' is partially clipped at the bottom of the screen; its name, rating, and delivery details are hidden behind or below the bottom tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the bottom navigation height so the last card is fully visible when scrolled.

issues.description: The top-right profile/notification area uses a plain circular placeholder with a small red dot, which looks like a missing avatar or ambiguous indicator.
issues.suggestion: Load the actual user avatar or use a clearer, labeled icon/placeholder for the profile or notification state.
